item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's father has fitted a convex mirror at the gate of their apartment building in Pune so that the security guard can watch a wide stretch of the road. Why is a convex mirror used here instead of a plane mirror?

options.A: It forms an image larger than the object, so vehicles look bigger.
options.B: It forms a real, inverted image that can be seen clearly at night.
options.C: It gives an erect, smaller image and a wider field of view of the road.
options.D: It reflects sunlight better, so it needs no electricity.
